_readme: The ONE profile file (data, not code). The first-run interview fills it; the skill reads it every run. It is saved as profile.json in the client workspace (the storage folder the client chose on the first run, saved by scripts/workspace.sh), NOT inside the skill folder, so skill updates never overwrite it. To add a service or a new client: edit this file only. Every fact carries a source or the word UNVERIFIED. An UNVERIFIED fact may not be used in a post as a claim.

service_area._note: city or region names only; never a street address

style._note: Optional look for on-screen text and covers. Hex colours like #1F5A3A. font_family must be a font installed on this computer (a Chinese-capable one). Leave empty for white text and the default font.

voice._register_note: spoken (like talking to a neighbour) | written | mixed
voice._sample_note: Optional style example; may be deferred while using the client-approved language and tone. All Chinese remains DRAFT until approved.

final_cut._length_note: 3 to 60 seconds; recommend 15–20 when unspecified, honor the client’s explicit choice
final_cut.music: Offer the free catalog with sign-in if BGM is requested; also allow provided licensed music, in-app music, or none
final_cut._note: Provisional reusable defaults; refine through the first storyline, storyboard and preview. Job requirements override these without changing future defaults.

red_lines._licence_note: Never say or imply licensed, insured, bonded, or any years-in-business number unless the client states it AND gives the source. Then add it to claims_sourced_by_client.

customer_permission._note: The skill asks the client for a yes before it uses footage of any customer's yard. Faces, house numbers and street signs are never shown.

contact_handoff._note: XHS forbids contact IDs, phone numbers, links and QR codes in posts, comments and DMs. The skill only writes plain-text hand-off wording that names no ID and no link.

automation._note: THREE separate switches. All false by default. XHS may limit accounts that use automation. When false, the skill prepares the draft and STOPS; the client sends.

system._browser_label_note: Only needed if several browsers are connected to bsk. Leave empty otherwise.
system._music_catalog_note: Last successful free-catalog retrieval verified during setup; recheck auth before catalog use. No credentials stored here.
